english: While seated behind the Gârhapatya, with his face turned toward the south , and the sacrificial cord on his right shoulder, he takes that (material for the offering from the cart) . Only once he cleans (the rice) ; for it is once for all that the fathers have passed away, and therefore he cleans it only once.
